verdicts.explanation: The abstract and Section 3.4.1 give 6.61 x 10-4 S/cm for 0.25 Ta at 250C (read as 25 °C, consistent with the 250C–1500C Arrhenius range), with a minimum activation energy of 0.25 eV. The sintering conditions (10500 C, 7.30 h, solid-state) match the paper's text, and relative density is correctly null.
